title: Easy Forms
description: Easy Forms is a modern, full-featured form builder and management platform enabling users to dynamically construct, publish, and analyze custom web forms with real-time analytics and automated export capabilities.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Users needed an intuitive, code-free interface to build complex, customizable forms with custom field types.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Engineered a flexible, component-driven form builder allowing users to assemble, preview, and deploy custom form schemas effortlessly.

title: Local LLM Memory
description: Local LLM Memory is a fully local, privacy-preserving AI coding assistant that combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with natural-language file and function operations via Ollama, ChromaDB, and structured intent routing.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Standard LLM chat models suggest code changes but cannot execute file operations, while generic commands often fail due to unstructured natural language.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Architected a dual-stage intent parser that extracts structured JSON payloads from raw prompt text and dispatches commands directly to local handlers.

title: High-Throughput Distributed Financial Ledger & Analytics Engine
description: A production-grade, asynchronous financial transaction engine built with Python (FastAPI) and SQLAlchemy 2.0 using CQRS architecture, Transactional Outbox pattern, Apache Kafka, and ClickHouse OLAP.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: High concurrency wallet transactions risk race conditions, dual-write desynchronization, and analytical reporting freezing OLTP operational database tables.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Isolated high-speed transaction updates (PostgreSQL OLTP + Transactional Outbox) from historical analytics (Kafka + ClickHouse OLAP) using CQRS architecture.
